envelope.description: Store the code-review round through the service on both routes

body.title: Store the code-review round through the service on both routes
body.summary: Add through to the code-review runner dependencies and store the record's body through updateContent before deps.write refreshes the json and markdown; supply the registry's RoundWriter from the code-review step handler and in every branch of codeReviewRunStart (degraded, injected write, default); migrate the tests of runCodeReview and the code-review step.
acceptanceChecks: the daemon route (codeReviewRunStart) and the controller route (the step handler) both log the code-review round through the service
a failed store fails the run's finalize and replaces no record
without through the finalize is unchanged

tests.name: round-recording.test.ts: runCodeReview with a RoundWriter stores the content through the service and logs the round on the daemon route and the controller route, and a failed store replaces no record
